```{r}
get_freq = function(x){
  wordfreq$zipf_frequency(x,"en")
}
```


```{r}
get_prev = function(current_dataset){
  back1 = current_dataset%>%distinct(itemid,wordnum,Surprisal,wlen,freq)%>%
  rename("Surprisal1p"="Surprisal",
         "wlen1p"="wlen",
         "freq1p"="freq")%>%
  mutate(wordnum=wordnum-1)%>%
  filter(wordnum>=1)%>%distinct()
  
  back2 = current_dataset%>%distinct(itemid,wordnum,Surprisal,wlen,freq)%>%
  rename("Surprisal2p"="Surprisal",
         "wlen2p"="wlen",
         "freq2p"="freq")%>%
  mutate(wordnum=wordnum-2)%>%
  filter(wordnum>=1)%>%distinct()

current_dataset = current_dataset%>%
  inner_join(back1,by=c("itemid","wordnum"))%>%
  inner_join(back2,by=c("itemid","wordnum"))%>%
  distinct()

current_dataset
}
```

```{r}
get_loglik = function(df,lang_code,model){
  df%>%
  rename("Surprisal"=all_of(model))%>%
  group_by(itemid,sentnum)%>%
  filter(wordnum!=min(wordnum))%>%
  filter(wordnum!=max(wordnum))%>%
  filter(lang==all_of(lang_code))%>%
  inner_join(get_prev(df%>%rename("Surprisal"=all_of(model))))%>%
  lmer(data = ., firstrun.dur ~ scale(Surprisal) + scale(Surprisal1p) + scale(Surprisal2p)+ scale(wordnum) + scale(wlen)+ scale(wlen1p)+ scale(wlen2p) + scale(freq)+ scale(freq1p)+ scale(freq2p) + (1+scale(Surprisal) + scale(Surprisal1p) + scale(Surprisal2p)+ scale(wordnum) + scale(wlen)+ scale(wlen1p)+ scale(wlen2p) + scale(freq)+ scale(freq1p)+ scale(freq2p)||subid),REML=F)%>%logLik()
}
```


```{r}
get_loglik_baseline = function(df,lang_code,model){
  df%>%
  rename("Surprisal"=all_of(model))%>%
  group_by(itemid,sentnum)%>%
  filter(wordnum!=min(wordnum))%>%
  filter(wordnum!=max(wordnum))%>%
  filter(lang==all_of(lang_code))%>%
  inner_join(get_prev(df%>%rename("Surprisal"=all_of(model))))%>%
  lmer(data = ., firstrun.dur ~ scale(wordnum) + scale(wlen)+ scale(wlen1p)+ scale(wlen2p) + scale(freq)+ scale(freq1p)+ scale(freq2p) + (1+ scale(wordnum) + scale(wlen)+ scale(wlen1p)+ scale(wlen2p) + scale(freq)+ scale(freq1p)+ scale(freq2p)||subid),REML=F)%>%logLik()
}
```

```{r}
results_summary_cleaned = results_summary%>%
  group_by(lang)%>%
  filter(model=="baseline")%>%
  rename("baseline_loglik"="logLik")%>%
  select(-model)%>%
  left_join(results_summary,.,by="lang")%>%
  filter(model!="baseline")%>%
  mutate(normalized_loglik = logLik-baseline_loglik)%>%
  mutate(model_class = case_when(str_detect(model,"mono") ~"mono",
                                 str_detect(model,"balanced") ~"L2 bal.",
                                 str_detect(model,"simultaneous") ~"L2 sim.",
                                 
                                 str_detect(model,"xglm") ~"XGLM",
                                 str_detect(model,"aya") ~"Aya",
                                 str_detect(model,"apertus") ~"Apertus",
                                 str_detect(model,"eurollm") ~"EuroLLM",
                                 ))

results_summary_cleaned%>%write_tsv("results_summary.tsv")


results_summary_cleaned%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=model_class,y=normalized_loglik,fill=model_class)) + geom_col(position="dodge") + facet_wrap(.~lang,scales="free_x")+
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank() 
  )
```
